properties.name: 唐桑半島東部 (Karakuwa Peninsula East)
properties.accuracy: approximate, traced from https://www.pref.miyagi.jp/documents/37871/kukakun.pdf (宮城海区漁場計画 令和5年一斉更新 区画漁業 北部, page 1 '区画 No.1 唐桑北部', CreationDate 2023-11-16)
properties.boundaryDefinition: 唐桑半島東部（岩手県陸前高田市と気仙沼市との境～気仙沼市唐桑町御崎）[from 807855.pdf]
properties.method: Coastal vertices geocoded from place names printed on the source map (OpenStreetMap Nominatim; see pipeline/data/zones/sources.json) from the Iwate-prefecture border near Osawa fishing port south to Cape Osaki, then offset seaward by roughly the aquaculture-plot depth shown on the map's 1:30,000 scale bar (order of 2-4km). Not surveyed; do not use for navigation or legal boundary purposes.
